Sp_AppQueryGrayIn.title: Sp_AppQueryGrayIn
Sp_AppQueryGrayIn.sql:
Select
ROW_NUMBER()OVER(ORDER BY gi.SheetDate Desc) AS rowIndex,
gi.SheetNo,
gid.ReceSheetNo,
CONVERT(Varchar(19),gi.SheetDate,21) AS SheetDate ,
SheetKind,
Case When
gi.SheetKind =11 Then '外厂入库'
When gi.SheetKind =10 Then '加捻入库'
When gi.SheetKind =15 Then '退回入库'
When gi.SheetKind =16 Then '退货出库'
When gi.SheetKind =18 Then '采购入库'
When gi.SheetKind =19 Then '其他入库'
End SheetKindName,
gi.CustomerID,
pc.ShortName AS customerName,
gid.GrayID,
Gr.NameC As GrayName,
Rolls,WeightQty,
gid.LotNo,gid.ColorID,ColorNum,YarnCategory,PreField1,OriJobsheetNo,gi.Creater,CONVERT(Varchar(19),gi.CreateDate,21)CreateDate

FROM dye.GrayIn gi
INNER JOIN dye.GrayInDetail gid ON gi.SheetSeries = gid.SheetSeries
left JOIN dye.p_Customer pc ON gi.CustomerID=pc.CustomerID
Left Join dye.p_Gray Gr On gid.GrayID=Gr.GrayID
WHERE  1=1
And gi.SheetKind<>16
And gi.SheetDate>=@dtStart And gi.SheetDate <@dtEnd
and  (ISNULL(@CustomerID,'')='' OR gi.CustomerID = @CustomerID)
and  (ISNULL(@GrayID,'')='' OR gid.GrayID = @GrayID)
and  (ISNULL(@LotNo,'')='' OR gid.LotNo like '%'+ @LotNo +'%' )

alis.InSheetKind,
gi.SheetNo,

alis.ReceSheetNo,gi.SheetKind,

gid.LotNo,alis.GrayID,Gr.NameC As GrayName,alis.Rolls,alis.LengthQty,alis.WeightQty,alis.PreField1,(SELECT STRING_AGG(d.Area,';') FROM dye.GrayStockBook b JOIN dye.GrayInDetail d ON b.ReceSheetNo=d.ReceSheetNo AND b.GrayID=d.GrayID WHERE ISNULL(b.WareHouseID,'')=alis.WareHouseID AND ISNULL(b.CustomerID,'')=alis.CustomerID AND ISNULL(b.InSheetKind,'')=alis.InSheetKind AND ISNULL(b.GrayID,'')=alis.GrayID AND ISNULL(b.LotNo,'')=alis.LotNo AND ISNULL(b.PreField1,'')=alis.PreField1 AND ISNULL(b.ColorID,'')=alis.ColorID AND ISNULL(b.FixedQty,0)=alis.FixedQty AND ISNULL(b.PurchaseOrders,'')=alis.PurchaseOrders AND ISNULL(b.A_A,'')=alis.A_A AND ISNULL(b.A_B,'')=alis.A_B) AS Area

LEFT JOIN dye.GrayInDetail gid ON alis.GrayID = gid.GrayID AND alis.ReceSheetNo = gid.ReceSheetNo
LEFT JOIN dye.GrayIn gi ON gid.SheetSeries=gi.SheetSeries

ROW_NUMBER()OVER(ORDER BY JobSheetNo Desc) AS rowIndex,
(SELECT CONVERT(Varchar(19),MAX(SheetDate),21) FROM dye.ProdIn WHERE JobSheetNo=alis.JobSheetNo) AS SheetDate,
alis.CustomerID,Cu.ShortName As CustomerName,JobSheetNo,ProdID,Gr.NameC As ProdName,ColorNum,alis.ColorID,
Rolls,LengthQty,GrayQty,WeightQty

From(
select CustomerID,
JobSheetNo,ProdID,ColorNum,ColorID,SUM(Rolls) Rolls,SUM(LengthQty) as LengthQty,sum(GrayQty)as GrayQty,SUM(WeightQty)as WeightQty from(
select CustomerID,
JobSheetNo,ProdID,ColorNum,ColorID,(ISNULL(c.InRolls,0)-ISNULL(c.OutRolls,0)) as Rolls,
(ISNULL(c.InLengthQty,0)-ISNULL(c.OutLengthQty,0)) as LengthQty ,(ISNULL(c.InWeightQty,0)-ISNULL(c.OutWeightQty,0)) as WeightQty,
(ISNULL(c.InGrayQty,0)-ISNULL(c.OutGrayQty,0)) as GrayQty,
c.Price from dye.ProdStockBook  c

group by CustomerID,JobSheetNo,ProdID,ColorNum,ColorID
) alis
left join dye.p_Customer  Cu On alis.CustomerID=Cu.CustomerID
left Join dye.p_Gray Gr on Gr.GrayID=alis.ProdID
Where 1=1
and  (ISNULL(@CustomerID,'')='' OR alis.CustomerID = @CustomerID)
and  (ISNULL(@ProdID,'')='' OR ProdID = @ProdID)

ROW_NUMBER()OVER(ORDER BY NEWID()) AS rowIndex,
StuffInfo.*
,WD.Name As  WareHouseName,
Case When  StuffType='S'Then '染料' End StuffTypeName,
SK.Name AS StuffKindName,

c.StuffKindID,

ISNULL(b.StuffID,'') AS StuffID,

fn_ArticlePrice.title: fn_ArticlePrice
fn_ArticlePrice.sql:
SELECT
 SUM(ISNULL(TotalMoney, 0)) AS money ,
 SUM(ISNULL(TotalQty, 0)) AS qty
FROM      (
SELECT    ISNULL(WareHouseID, '') AS WareHouseID ,
ISNULL(ArticleID, '') AS ArticleID ,
ISNULL(ArticleKindID, '') AS ArticleKindID ,
(ISNULL(c.InQty, 0) ) AS TotalQty ,
ISNULL(c.Price,0)*ISNULL(c.InQty, 0) AS TotalMoney
FROM      ArticleStockBook c
WHERE     c.BookKind IN ( 11, 13, 14, 16, 19 )
AND c.BookDate > (
SELECT
MAX(CarryDate) AS CarryDate
FROM
(
SELECT
CAST('1900-01-01' AS DATETIME) AS CarryDate
UNION
SELECT
MAX(ISNULL(CarryDate,CAST('1900-01-01' AS DATETIME))) AS CarryDate
FROM
ArticleStock
WHERE
WareHouseID = c.WareHouseID
AND ArticleID = c.ArticleID
AND ArticleKindID = c.ArticleKindID
GROUP BY WareHouseID ,
ArticleID ,
ArticleKindID
) alisMaxCarryDate
)
UNION ALL
SELECT    ISNULL(a.WareHouseID, '') AS WareHouseID ,
ISNULL(a.ArticleID, '') AS ArticleID ,
ISNULL(a.ArticleKindID, '') AS ArticleKindID ,
a.PreMonthQty AS TotalQty ,
a.PreMonthMoney AS TotalMoney
FROM      ArticleStock a
INNER JOIN ( SELECT
MAX(CarryDate) AS CarryDate ,
WareHouseID ,
ArticleID ,
ArticleKindID
FROM  ArticleStock
GROUP BY WareHouseID ,
ArticleID ,
ArticleKindID
) b ON a.WareHouseID = b.WareHouseID
AND a.ArticleID = b.ArticleID
AND a.ArticleKindID = b.ArticleKindID
AND a.CarryDate = b.CarryDate
) alisTotal
WHERE   ArticleID = @ArticleID
AND ArticleKindID = @ArticleKindID
AND WareHouseID = @WareHouseID

fn_ArticlePriceMovingAverage.title: fn_ArticlePriceMovingAverage
fn_ArticlePriceMovingAverage.sql:
SELECT   SUM(ISNULL(TotalMoney, 0)) AS money,
 SUM(ISNULL(TotalQty, 0)) AS qty
FROM    (
SELECT    ISNULL(a.WareHouseID, '') AS WareHouseID ,
ISNULL(a.ArticleID, '') AS ArticleID ,
a.PreMonthQty AS TotalQty ,
a.PreMonthMoney AS TotalMoney
FROM      ArticleStock a
INNER JOIN ( SELECT MAX(CarryDate) AS CarryDate ,
WareHouseID ,
ArticleID
FROM   ArticleStock
GROUP BY WareHouseID ,
ArticleID
) b ON a.WareHouseID = b.WareHouseID
AND a.ArticleID = b.ArticleID
AND a.CarryDate = b.CarryDate
WHERE     a.WareHouseID = @WareHouseID
AND a.ArticleID = @ArticleCode
UNION ALL
SELECT    ISNULL(WareHouseID, '') AS WareHouseID ,
ISNULL(ArticleID, '') AS ArticleID ,
( ISNULL(c.InQty, 0) - ISNULL(c.OutQty, 0) ) AS TotalQty ,
( ISNULL(c.InMoney, 0)- ISNULL(c.OutMoney, 0) ) AS TotalMoney
FROM      ArticleStockBook c
WHERE     c.WareHouseID = @WareHouseID
AND c.BookKind NOT IN (18,22,14)
AND c.ArticleID = @ArticleCode
AND c.BookDate < @dtInputDate
AND c.BookDate > (SELECT MAX(CarryDate) FROM (SELECT CAST('1900-01-01' AS DATETIME) CarryDate UNION ALL SELECT ISNULL(CarryDate,CAST('1900-01-01' AS DATETIME)) FROM dye.ArticleStock WHERE WareHouseID=@WareHouseID AND ArticleID=@ArticleCode) dates)
UNION ALL
SELECT    ISNULL(WareHouseID, '') AS WareHouseID ,
ISNULL(ArticleID, '') AS ArticleID ,

fn_StuffPrice.title: fn_StuffPrice
fn_StuffPrice.sql:
SELECT   SUM(ISNULL(TotalMoney, 0)) AS money,
 SUM(ISNULL(TotalQty, 0)) AS qty
FROM    (
SELECT    ISNULL(WareHouseID, '') AS WareHouseID ,
ISNULL(StuffID, '') AS StuffID ,
( ISNULL(c.InQty, 0) ) AS TotalQty ,
ISNULL(c.Price, 0) * ISNULL(c.InQty, 0) AS TotalMoney
FROM      StuffStockBook c
WHERE     c.WareHouseID = @WareHouseID
AND c.StuffID = @StuffCode
AND c.BookKind IN ( 11, 13, 14, 16, 19 )
AND c.BookDate > (SELECT MAX(CarryDate) FROM (SELECT CAST('1900-01-01' AS DATETIME) CarryDate UNION ALL SELECT ISNULL(CarryDate,CAST('1900-01-01' AS DATETIME)) FROM dye.StuffStock WHERE WareHouseID=@WareHouseID AND StuffID=@StuffCode) dates)
UNION ALL
SELECT    ISNULL(a.WareHouseID, '') AS WareHouseID ,
ISNULL(a.StuffID, '') AS StuffID ,
a.PreMonthQty AS TotalQty ,
a.PreMonthMoney AS TotalMoney
FROM      StuffStock a
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT  MAX(CarryDate) AS CarryDate ,
WareHouseID ,
StuffID
FROM    StuffStock
GROUP BY WareHouseID ,
StuffID
) b ON a.WareHouseID = b.WareHouseID
AND a.StuffID = b.StuffID
AND a.CarryDate = b.CarryDate
LEFT JOIN StuffStockBook c ON a.WareHouseID = c.WareHouseID
AND c.StuffID = b.StuffID
WHERE     a.WareHouseID = @WareHouseID
AND a.StuffID = @StuffCode
) alisTotal
WHERE   StuffID = @StuffCode
AND WareHouseID = @WareHouseID

SP_QueryStuffCurrentStock.sql: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY NEWID()) AS rowIndex, d.Name AS StuffName, d.StockUnit, d.StuffKindID, d.StuffType, ISNULL(WareHouseID, '') AS WareHouseID, ISNULL(alis.StuffID, '') AS StuffID, ISNULL(alis.StuffID, '') AS StuffNewID, ISNULL(LotNo, '') AS LotNo, CONVERT(NUMERIC(10, 2), Qty) AS Qty, CONVERT(NUMERIC(10, 2), SafeQty) AS SafeQty, alis.Total, WD.Name AS WareHouseName, CASE WHEN StuffType = 'S' THEN '染料' END AS StuffTypeName, SK.Name AS StuffKindName, CASE WHEN StockUnit = 'K' THEN '千克' END AS UnitName FROM (SELECT WareHouseID AS WareHouseID, StuffID AS StuffID, LotNo AS LotNo, SUM(Qty) AS Qty, SUM(Total) AS Total FROM (SELECT ISNULL(WareHouseID, '') AS WareHouseID, ISNULL(StuffID, '') AS StuffID, ISNULL(LotNo, '') AS LotNo, (ISNULL(c.InQty, 0) - ISNULL(c.OutQty, 0)) AS Qty, (ISNULL(c.InMoney, 0) - ISNULL(c.OutMoney, 0)) AS Total FROM dye.StuffStockBook AS c WHERE c.BookKind IN (11, 13, 14, 15, 16, 19, 33, 21, 22, 23, 24, 25, 29) AND c.BookDate > (SELECT MAX(CarryDate) AS CarryDate FROM (SELECT CAST('1900-01-01' AS DATETIME) AS CarryDate UNION SELECT MAX(ISNULL(CarryDate, CAST('1900-01-01' AS DATETIME))) AS CarryDate FROM dye.StuffStock WHERE WareHouseID = c.WareHouseID AND StuffID = c.StuffID AND ISNULL(LotNo, '') = ISNULL(c.LotNo, '') GROUP BY WareHouseID, StuffID, LotNo) AS alisMaxCarryDate) UNION ALL SELECT ISNULL(a.WareHouseID, '') AS WareHouseID, ISNULL(a.StuffID, '') AS StuffID, ISNULL(a.LotNo, '') AS LotNo, a.PreMonthQty AS Qty, a.Price * a.PreMonthQty AS Total FROM dye.StuffStock AS a INNER JOIN (SELECT MAX(CarryDate) AS CarryDate, WareHouseID AS WareHouseID, StuffID AS StuffID, LotNo AS LotNo FROM dye.StuffStock GROUP BY WareHouseID, StuffID, LotNo) AS b ON a.WareHouseID = b.WareHouseID AND a.StuffID = b.StuffID AND ISNULL(a.LotNo, '') = ISNULL(b.LotNo, '') AND a.CarryDate = b.CarryDate) AS alisTotal GROUP BY WareHouseID, StuffID, LotNo) AS alis LEFT JOIN dye.p_Stuff AS d ON alis.StuffID = d.StuffID LEFT JOIN dye.p_FieldValid AS SK ON Sk.Code = d.StuffKindID AND SK.FieldType = 'StuffKind' LEFT JOIN dye.p_FieldValid AS WD ON WD.Code = alis.WareHouseID AND WD.FieldType = 'WareHouseID' WHERE (ISNULL(@StuffID, '') = '' OR alis.StuffID = @StuffID) AND (ISNULL(@WareHouseID, '') = '' OR WareHouseID = @WareHouseID) ORDER BY StockUnit, alis.StuffID

ISNULL(lsf.qtdj, '0') AS QTDJ, oae.price AS ZGJDDJ, fod.Price AS SGDJ FROM (SELECT a.JobSheetNo AS JobSheetNo, SUM(a.InRolls) AS rolls, SUM(InWeightQty) AS WeightQty, SUM(InGrayQty) AS grayQty, SUM(a.InLengthQty) AS LengthQty FROM dye.ProdStockBook AS a LEFT JOIN dye.jobsheet AS j ON a.JobSheetNo = j.SheetNo LEFT JOIN dye.OrderColor AS oc ON oc.checkno = j.checkno LEFT JOIN dye.FeelOfferDetail AS fod ON fod.FeelCode = oc.Edge AND fod.ProdID = oc.CustFabricName LEFT JOIN dye.ordermain AS om ON om.SheetSeries = oc.SheetSeries LEFT JOIN dye.p_Product AS p ON p.ProdID = j.CustSelfProduct LEFT JOIN dye.ProdIn AS pn ON pn.JobSheetNo = j.SheetNo AND pn.SheetNo = a.SheetNo WHERE NOT a.customerid IN ('040', '039', '043', '041', '050', '051', '055', '058') AND a.BookDate >= @StartDate AND a.BookDate <= @EndDate AND a.BookKind = '11' GROUP BY a.JobSheetNo) AS a LEFT JOIN dye.prodin AS pn ON pn.JobSheetNo = a.JobSheetNo AND pn.sheetkind IN ('10', '11', '16') AND pn.sheetdate >= @StartDate AND pn.sheetdate <= @EndDate LEFT JOIN dye.jobsheet AS j ON a.JobSheetNo = j.SheetNo LEFT JOIN dye.OrderColor AS oc ON oc.checkno = j.checkno LEFT JOIN (SELECT SheetSeries AS SheetSeries, SUM(Price) AS price FROM dye.OrderAtte WHERE (AtteValue LIKE '%胶袋%' OR AtteValue LIKE '%纸管%') AND NULLIF(Price, '0') <> '0' GROUP BY SheetSeries) AS oae ON oae.SheetSeries = oc.SheetSeries LEFT JOIN dye.FeelOfferDetail AS fod ON fod.FeelCode = oc.Edge AND fod.ProdID = oc.CustFabricName LEFT JOIN dye.ordermain AS om ON om.SheetSeries = oc.SheetSeries LEFT JOIN (SELECT sheetseries AS sheetseries, SUM(Price) AS qtdj FROM dye.orderatte WHERE FieldType = '05' AND NULLIF(price, '0') <> '0' AND (AtteValue LIKE '%抓毛%' OR AtteValue LIKE '刷毛' OR AtteValue LIKE '%剪毛%') GROUP BY sheetseries) AS lsf ON lsf.SheetSeries = om.SheetSeries) AS aa GROUP BY aa.CustomerID, aa.Jobkindid) AS kk GROUP BY kk.CustomerID, kk.Jobkind

(SELECT CAST(a.SheetDate AS DATE) AS 日期, c.DisplayValue AS 物流类型, f.Name AS 车牌号, CASE WHEN a.SheetKind = '11' THEN '收坯' WHEN a.SheetKind = '15' THEN '客退入库' ELSE '退坯' END AS 收发, e.NameC AS 客户, ISNULL(d.匹数, '0') AS 匹数, ISNULL(d.重量, '0') AS 重量, b.DisplayValue AS 收发地点, f.Reserved3 AS 车型, '0' AS 送货运费, CASE WHEN g.leixing <> '9' THEN ISNULL(g.inprice, '0') ELSE ISNULL(g.inprice, '0') * ISNULL(d.重量, '0') END AS 收坯运费 FROM dye.GrayIn AS a LEFT JOIN dye.s_DBComboValue AS b ON b.KeyValue = a.combo1 AND b.ComboID = 'B042' LEFT JOIN dye.s_DBComboValue AS c ON c.KeyValue = a.WLLX AND c.ComboID = 'C041' LEFT JOIN (SELECT SheetSeries AS SheetSeries, SUM(ISNULL(Rolls, '0')) AS 匹数, SUM(ISNULL(WeightQty, '0')) AS 重量, SUM(ISNULL(LengthQty, '0')) AS 长度 FROM dye.GrayInDetail GROUP BY SheetSeries) AS d ON d.SheetSeries = a.SheetSeries LEFT JOIN dye.p_Customer AS e ON e.CustomerID = a.CustomerID LEFT JOIN dye.p_FieldValid AS f ON f.Code = a.CarNo AND f.FieldType = 'CVehicle' LEFT JOIN dye.yunfeibiaozhun AS g ON g.Address = b.DisplayValue AND g.LeiXing = f.Reserved5 WHERE (a.SheetKind <> '14' AND a.SheetDate >= @StartDate AND a.SheetDate <= @EndDate) UNION ALL SELECT CAST(a.SheetDate AS DATE) AS 日期, c.DisplayValue AS 物流类型, f.Name AS 车牌号, '成品送货' AS 收发, e.NameC AS 客户, ISNULL(d.匹数, '0') AS 匹数, ISNULL(d.重量, '0') AS 重量, b.DisplayValue AS 收发地点, f.Reserved3 AS 车型, ISNULL(g.outPrice, '0') AS 送货运费, '0' AS 收坯运费 FROM dye.ProdOut AS a LEFT JOIN dye.s_DBComboValue AS b ON b.KeyValue = a.combo1 AND b.ComboID = 'B042' LEFT JOIN dye.s_DBComboValue AS c ON c.KeyValue = a.WLLX AND c.ComboID = 'C041' LEFT JOIN (SELECT SheetSeries AS SheetSeries, SUM(ISNULL(Rolls, '0')) AS 匹数, SUM(ISNULL(WeightQty, '0')) AS 重量, SUM(ISNULL(LengthQty, '0')) AS 长度 FROM dye.ProdOutDetail GROUP BY SheetSeries) AS d ON d.SheetSeries = a.SheetSeries LEFT JOIN dye.p_Customer AS e ON e.CustomerID = a.CustomerID LEFT JOIN dye.p_FieldValid AS f ON f.Code = a.CarNo AND f.FieldType = 'CVehicle' LEFT JOIN dye.yunfeibiaozhun AS g ON g.Address = b.DisplayValue AND g.LeiXing = f.Reserved5 WHERE a.SheetDate >= @StartDate AND a.SheetDate <= @EndDate) AS aa GROUP BY 日期, 物流类型, 车牌号, 收发, 收发地点, 客户, 车型, 收坯运费, 送货运费
temps.tb: SELECT CAST(a.日期 AS DATE) AS [日期], @days AS [days], a.物流类型 AS [物流类型], a.车牌号 AS [车牌号], a.收发 AS [收发], a.收发地点 AS [收发地点], a.客户 AS [客户], a.车型 AS [车型], ABS(a.匹数) AS [匹数], ABS(a.重量) AS [重量], b.送货运费 + b.收坯运费 AS [元/车], a.重量 / NULLIF(b.重量, '0') * b.送货运费 AS [送货运费], a.重量 / NULLIF(b.重量, '0') * b.收坯运费 AS [收坯运费], ABS(a.重量) / 1000 * 15 AS [装卸费], CONVERT(NUMERIC(16, 2), 0) AS [中转费], a.重量 / NULLIF(b.重量, '0') * (b.收坯运费 + b.送货运费) + ABS(a.重量) / 1000 * 15 AS [费用合计], '' AS [备注], CASE WHEN a.收发 IN ('收坯', '客退入库') THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS [收发类型] FROM #t AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(日期 AS DATE) AS 日期, 物流类型 AS 物流类型, 车牌号 AS 车牌号, MAX(收坯运费) AS 收坯运费, MAX(送货运费) AS 送货运费, SUM(匹数) AS 匹数, SUM(重量) AS 重量, CASE WHEN 收发 IN ('收坯', '客退入库') THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS 收发类型 FROM #t GROUP BY CAST(日期 AS DATE), 物流类型, 车牌号, CASE WHEN 收发 IN ('收坯', '客退入库') THEN 2 ELSE 1 END) AS b ON b.日期 = a.日期 AND b.物流类型 = a.物流类型 AND b.车牌号 = a.车牌号 AND b.收发类型 = CASE WHEN a.收发 IN ('收坯', '客退入库') THEN 2 ELSE 1 END WHERE a.日期 >= @StartDate AND a.日期 <= @EndDate

aggregates:
SELECT SUM(OrderRolls) OrderRolls,
SUM(OrderQty) OrderQty
FROM dye.OrderMain a
JOIN dye.OrderColor b
ON a.SheetSeries = b.SheetSeries
WHERE a.SheetDate >= @DT0
AND a.SheetDate < @DT1
AND a.CustomerID <> '039'

SUM(gi.DlvWeightQty) DlvWeightQty
FROM dye.GrayIn gi
INNER JOIN dye.p_Customer pc
ON gi.CustomerID = pc.CustomerID
WHERE gi.SheetDate >= @DT0
AND gi.SheetDate < @DT1
AND gi.SheetKind = 11
SELECT SUM(GaryWeight) AS GaryWeight,
SUM(Rolls) AS GaryRolls
FROM dye.ProdIn a
WHERE a.SheetDate >= @DT0
AND a.SheetDate < @DT1
AND a.CustomerID <> '039'
SELECT SUM(Rolls) PBRolls,
SUM(WeightQty) PBWeightQty
FROM
(
SELECT BusinessUnitID,
CustomerID,
WareHouseID,
SalerGroupID,
GrayID,
ReceSheetNo,
SUM(Rolls) Rolls,
SUM(WeightQty) AS WeightQty
FROM
(
SELECT ISNULL(BusinessUnitID, '') AS BusinessUnitID,
CustomerID,
WareHouseID,
ISNULL(StorageUnitIDs, '') AS StorageUnitIDs,
ISNULL(SalerGroupID, '') AS SalerGroupID,
GrayID,
LotNo,
ReceSheetNo,
(ISNULL(InRolls, 0) - ISNULL(OutRolls, 0)) AS Rolls,
(ISNULL(InLengthQty, 0) - ISNULL(OutLengthQty, 0)) AS LengthQty,
(ISNULL(InWeightQty, 0) - ISNULL(OutWeightQty, 0)) AS WeightQty,
Price
FROM dye.GrayStockBook
) c
GROUP BY BusinessUnitID,
CustomerID,
WareHouseID,
SalerGroupID,
GrayID,
ReceSheetNo
) alis
WHERE (alis.Rolls > 0)
AND alis.CustomerID NOT IN
(
SELECT CustomerID
FROM dye.p_Customer
WHERE ShortName IN ( '1666', '1999', '345346', '2888', '2666', '9008' )
)
select SUM(Rolls) CPRolls,SUM(WeightQty) CPWeightQty
FROM (
select BusinessUnitID,CustomerID,WareHouseID,SalerGroupID,GrayID,
ReceSheetNo,SUM(Rolls) Rolls,SUM(WeightQty)as WeightQty from(
select ISNULL(BusinessUnitID,'') AS BusinessUnitID,CustomerID,WareHouseID,ISNULL(StorageUnitIDs,'') AS StorageUnitIDs,ISNULL(SalerGroupID,'') AS SalerGroupID,GrayID,
LotNo,ReceSheetNo,(ISNULL(InRolls,0)-ISNULL(OutRolls,0)) as Rolls,
(ISNULL(InLengthQty,0)-ISNULL(OutLengthQty,0)) as LengthQty ,(ISNULL(InWeightQty,0)-ISNULL(OutWeightQty,0)) as WeightQty,
Price from dye.GrayStockBook
)c
group by BusinessUnitID,CustomerID,WareHouseID,SalerGroupID,GrayID,ReceSheetNo
) alis WHERE (alis. Rolls>0)
AND alis.CustomerID NOT IN (SELECT CustomerID FROM dye.p_Customer WHERE ShortName IN ('1666','1999','345346','2888','2666','9008'))

sp_zhenzhiribaobiao.title: 针织日报原汇总
sp_zhenzhiribaobiao.sql: SELECT a.日期 AS [日期], a.下单 AS [下单], a.下单匹数 AS [下单匹数], a.下单数量 AS [下单数量], b.正常开卡 AS [正常开卡], b.预配匹数 AS [预配匹数], b.预配数量 AS [预配数量], ISNULL(j.回修开卡, 0) AS [列7], ISNULL(j.回修预配匹数, 0) AS [列8], ISNULL(j.回修预配数量, 0) AS [列9], c.在制品缸数 AS [在制品缸数], c.在制品匹数 AS [在制品匹数], c.在制品数量 AS [在制品数量], d.出缸数 AS [出缸数], d.出缸匹数 AS [出缸匹数], d.出缸数量 AS [出缸数量], e.成定缸数 AS [成定缸数], e.成定匹数 AS [成定匹数], e.成定数量 AS [成定数量], f.打卷缸数 AS [打卷缸数], f.打卷坯重 AS [打卷坯重], f.打卷成品重 AS [打卷成品重], g.入库单数 AS [入库单数], g.入库匹数 AS [入库匹数], g.入库坯重 AS [入库坯重], g.入库成品重 AS [入库成品重], h.库存成品匹数 AS [库存成品匹数], h.库存成品坯重 AS [库存成品坯重], h.库存成品重量 AS [库存成品重量], i.库存坯布匹数 AS [库存坯布匹数], i.库存坯重 AS [库存坯重] FROM (SELECT CAST(DATEADD(day,-1,GETDATE()) AS DATE) AS 日期, SUM(b.下单数) AS 下单, SUM(b.下单匹数) AS 下单匹数, SUM(b.下单数量) AS 下单数量 FROM dye.ordermain AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT SheetSeries AS SheetSeries, COUNT(SheetSeries) AS 下单数, SUM(OrderRolls) AS 下单匹数, ISNULL(SUM(OrderQty), 0) AS 下单数量 FROM dye.OrderColor GROUP BY SheetSeries) AS b ON b.SheetSeries = a.SheetSeries WHERE a.SheetDate >= DATEADD(day,-1,GETDATE()) AND a.SheetDate <= GETDATE()) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(DATEADD(day,-1,GETDATE()) AS DATE) AS 日期, COUNT(SheetSeries) AS 正常开卡, SUM(PreRolls) AS 预配匹数, SUM(PreVatQty) AS 预配数量 FROM dye.JobSheet WHERE sheetno NOT LIKE '%A%' AND sheetno NOT LIKE '%R%' AND SheetDate >= DATEADD(day,-1,GETDATE()) AND SheetDate <= GETDATE()) AS b ON b.日期 = a.日期 LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(DATEADD(day,-1,GETDATE()) AS DATE) AS 日期, COUNT(SheetSeries) AS 回修开卡, SUM(PreRolls) AS 回修预配匹数, SUM(PreVatQty) AS 回修预配数量 FROM dye.JobSheet WHERE (sheetno LIKE '%A%' OR sheetno LIKE '%R%') AND SheetDate >= DATEADD(day,-1,GETDATE()) AND SheetDate <= GETDATE()) AS j ON j.日期 = a.日期 LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(DATEADD(day,-1,GETDATE()) AS DATE) AS 日期, COUNT(*) AS 在制品缸数, SUM(PreRolls) AS 在制品匹数, SUM(PreVatQty) AS 在制品数量 FROM dye.vw_JobSheetCurr WHERE sheetdate <= GETDATE()) AS c ON c.日期 = a.日期 LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(DATEADD(day,-1,GETDATE()) AS DATE) AS 日期, COUNT(*) AS 出缸数, SUM(Rolls) AS 出缸匹数, SUM(WeightQty) AS 出缸数量 FROM dye.JobSheetReceive WHERE CreateDate >= DATEADD(day,-1,GETDATE()) AND CreateDate <= GETDATE()) AS d ON d.日期 = a.日期 LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(DATEADD(day,-1,GETDATE()) AS DATE) AS 日期, COUNT(*) AS 成定缸数, SUM(CurrRolls) AS 成定匹数, SUM(CurrKg) AS 成定数量 FROM dye.WProcess WHERE processid = 'GX31' AND EndTime >= DATEADD(day,-1,GETDATE()) AND EndTime <= GETDATE()) AS e ON e.日期 = a.日期 LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(DATEADD(day,-1,GETDATE()) AS DATE) AS 日期, COUNT(*) AS 打卷缸数, SUM(GrayWeight) AS 打卷坯重, SUM(RealQty) AS 打卷成品重 FROM dye.RecordYield WHERE PackTime >= DATEADD(day,-1,GETDATE()) AND PackTime <= GETDATE()) AS f ON f.日期 = a.日期 LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(DATEADD(day,-1,GETDATE()) AS DATE) AS 日期, COUNT(*) AS 入库单数, SUM(Rolls) AS 入库匹数, SUM(GaryWeight) AS 入库坯重, SUM(WeightQty) AS 入库成品重 FROM dye.ProdIn WHERE SheetDate >= DATEADD(day,-1,GETDATE()) AND SheetDate <= GETDATE()) AS g ON g.日期 = a.日期 LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(DATEADD(day,-1,GETDATE()) AS DATE) AS 日期, SUM(InRolls) - SUM(OutRolls) AS 库存成品匹数, SUM(InGrayQty) - SUM(OutGrayQty) AS 库存成品坯重, SUM(InWeightQty) - SUM(OutWeightQty) AS 库存成品重量 FROM dye.ProdStockBook WHERE NOT CustomerID IN ('040', '039', '043', '041', '050', '051', '055', '058', '059') AND BookDate <= GETDATE()) AS h ON h.日期 = a.日期 LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(DATEADD(day,-1,GETDATE()) AS DATE) AS 日期, SUM(InRolls) - SUM(OutRolls) AS 库存坯布匹数, SUM(InWeightQty) - SUM(OutWeightQty) AS 库存坯重 FROM dye.GrayStockBook WHERE NOT CustomerID IN ('040', '039', '043', '041', '050', '051', '055', '058', '059') AND BookDate <= GETDATE()) AS i ON i.日期 = a.日期
